brief: A screenless desk tutor for kids 6 to 14: it sees the homework through a downward camera, hears through microphones and talks through a speaker; the thinking happens in the cloud.
product: Ponder, a screenless AI tutor desk unit
mustHave: Downward camera that sees a whole US Letter or A4 page lying in front of the base and can read pencil handwriting
Two microphones that pick up a child's voice across a desk
Speaker loud enough for a desk, driven digitally (I2S)
Wi-Fi to reach the cloud model; no screen
Hardware microphone mute: a switch that physically cuts the microphones, with a light that shows it
Camera-on light next to the lens
One big talk button a 6-year-old can press
Weighted base that does not tip with the camera head reaching over the page
No small detachable parts, rounded edges, survives a fall from desk height
Built from off-the-shelf Raspberry Pi parts and breakout boards: no custom PCB in this version
niceToHave: Status light strip on the base (listening, thinking, speaking)
Bluetooth for headphones (the Pi Zero 2 W has it on board)

constraints.power: USB-C 5 V wall supply only, no battery in this version
constraints.pageSizes: US Letter 216 x 279 mm and A4 210 x 297 mm
constraints.pcb: none: breakouts, HATs and protoboard only
constraints.madeParts: 3D printed (PA12 MJF or PETG); everything else bought
constraints.localStorage: no video or audio stored on the device
constraints.fabrication: soldering iron, heat-set insert tip, screwdriver, 3D print service
